ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions across the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity (dark) pigmentation is concentrated as a continuous 10-20 pixel-wide band along the trailing edge and becomes high-density, irregular geometric masses at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to lobe height of roughly 15%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge perimeter, characterized by jagged pixel-steps varying between 2-8 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the peduncle base transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of small, low-intensity punctate spots (3-5 pixels each) observed in the lower-right quadrant of the white ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, ragged indentation and loss of smooth contour on the far-left distal tip, suggesting previous mechanical trauma or amputation of the edge.
